---
title: "Bernoulli and grouped binomial"
---

Bernoulli and grouped binomial outcomes are discrete, so exact R/Stata comparisons require shared uniforms through `uvar()` in benchmarks.

```stata
clear
set obs 80
set seed 20260510
generate double x = (_n - 40) / 20
generate double p = invlogit(-.2 + .8*x)
generate byte y = runiform() < p
logit y x
qresid rq_logit, seed(101) family(bernoulli)
qnorm rq_logit
```

For grouped binomial, always explain the trials denominator and distinguish it from generic weights.
